segments.1: Sequence 1: Me, my friends and my family

lessons.topic: Reading: describing people

lessons.topic: Writing my profile

objectives: Interpret a written message about clothes and shopping

lessons.topic: Writing about shops where I live
objectives: Write about shops where he/she lives

lessons.topic: Writing a report about shopping in another town or country
objectives: Write a report about shopping in another town or country

lessons.topic: Body parts

lessons.topic: Health problems
objectives: Talk about health problems related to body parts

lessons.topic: Common health problems and treatment

lessons.topic: /tʃ/ and /ʃ/ (ch and sh)

lessons.topic: Giving advice with the imperative

lessons.topic: Obligation and lack of obligation: have to / don't have to

lessons.topic: Reading: a balanced diet

notes: Lesson plans by Mr Bendoubaba Djamel (Bormadia, Relizane), 2nd-generation MS2 coursebook, all four sequences. Skipped: cover/sequence title pages (p1, 25, 49), blank pages 40 and 46, and p61–62 (lesson 'Lessons:6 I pronounce', a near-duplicate of lesson 5 ch/sh on p59–60). Sequence 4 starts with its initial situation (p73) and ends with past-simple worksheets (p90–98) but has no 'I learn to integrate' / 'I think and write' lesson; sequences 1–3 have no initial-situation page. The 'domain' field holds the lesson rubric (I listen and do, Language use, I pronounce, I read and do...). Durations not stated.
